title.en: Nazik al-Malaika: poetic form and women’s intellectual work
title.zh: 娜齐克·马莱卡：诗体与女性思想劳动

summary.en:
Nazik al-Malaika was an Iraqi poet and critic associated with the development of modern Arabic free verse. The movement changed relationships between inherited meter, the shape of a line and the expression of contemporary experience. Her role belongs within a field of other poets and arguments; presenting one writer as the sole inventor would flatten a collaborative and contested literary history.

A woman’s work as both poet and critic challenges histories in which women appear only as symbols or subjects of poetry. Her career also extends beyond any one national political turning point. This biography offers a connection between twentieth-century state history and intellectual life without reducing poems to direct illustrations of a government’s policy. No copyrighted verse is reproduced or translated here; readers are directed to published texts and translations for the works themselves.

娜齐克·马莱卡是与现代阿拉伯语自由诗发展相关的伊拉克诗人、批评家。运动改变继承的格律、诗行形态与当代经验表达之间的关系。她的作用应放在其他诗人和论辩构成的领域中；把一人称为唯一发明者，会抹平协作且有争议的文学史。

女性同时作为诗人和批评家工作，挑战女性只作为诗歌象征或对象出现的叙述。其生涯也超出任何单一国家政治转折。本传连接二十世纪国家史和思想生活，不把诗作缩成政府政策的直接图解。本条不复制或翻译受版权保护的诗句，作品本身应查阅出版文本和译本。

title.en: 1980–1988: the Iran–Iraq War and a monitored ceasefire
title.zh: 1980—1988年：两伊战争与受监督的停火

summary.en:
Iraq invaded Iran in September 1980, beginning a prolonged interstate war. Territorial disputes, revolutionary politics and regional calculations interacted; the conflict should not be reduced to a timeless struggle between two religions or peoples. Fighting affected civilians, soldiers, border towns, economic infrastructure and shipping.

The 1988 ceasefire was followed by UN monitoring intended to verify compliance and the withdrawal of forces. Creating an observer mission and ending major combat did not immediately repair damaged communities or settle every dispute. The atlas links this conflict to Iran’s revolutionary transition and Iraq’s later history while distinguishing wars that had different causes and participants. The representative border-region point is an orientation aid, not a map of the changing front or a complete list of affected places.

伊拉克于1980年9月入侵伊朗，开启长期国家间战争。领土争议、革命政治与区域盘算相互作用，不能把冲突缩为两个宗教或民族之间永恒的斗争。战事影响平民、士兵、边城、经济设施和航运。

1988年停火后，联合国开展监督，旨在核实遵守停火及部队撤离。建立观察团和主要战斗停止，并不会立即修复受损社群或解决全部争端。本条连接伊朗革命转型和伊拉克后续历史，同时区分原因、参与者不同的战争。边境代表点只是定位辅助，不是变化战线的地图，也不是受影响地点的完整清单。

title.en: 2003–2004: invasion, occupation and a new Iraqi interim government
title.zh: 2003—2004年：入侵、占领与伊拉克临时政府

summary.en:
A US- and British-led coalition invaded Iraq in March 2003 and took Baghdad in April. The Coalition Provisional Authority became the occupying administration, while the UN Security Council addressed the authority’s responsibilities and a role for Iraqi institutions and the United Nations. A later resolution about occupation should not be read as a simple statement that the earlier decision to invade had been universally authorized or accepted.

In June 2004 authority was transferred to an Iraqi interim government and the CPA ceased to exist. That institutional event did not end violence or establish that sovereignty was experienced without external constraints. Reading the US diplomatic chronology alongside the contemporary UN record distinguishes invasion, occupation and formal transfer. It also leaves space for civilian experience and Iraqi political actors beyond the administrations named in official documents.
summary.zh:
美国、英国主导的联盟于2003年3月入侵伊拉克，4月攻入巴格达。联盟临时管理当局成为占领管理机构，联合国安理会则处理其职责，以及伊拉克机构和联合国的作用。后来的占领决议不能简单解读为此前入侵已获得普遍授权或接受。

2004年6月，权力移交伊拉克临时政府，联盟临时管理当局停止存在。这一制度事件没有结束暴力，也不能证明主权实践已不受外部约束。把美国外交编年与同时代联合国记录并读，可以区分入侵、占领和正式移交，也为官方文件列名机构之外的平民经验及伊拉克政治行动者保留空间。

dateNote.en: March 2003 invasion to June 2004 formal transfer focus. Resolution 1483 dated 22May 2003 concerns post-invasion arrangements; no present legal or security status is asserted.

title.en: 1979–1989: Soviet intervention and Afghan displacement
title.zh: 1979—1989年：苏联介入与阿富汗人流离

summary.en:
Soviet troops entered Afghanistan in December 1979 after a period of Afghan political upheaval and growing Soviet involvement. The resulting war connected local struggles with Cold War intervention and outside support to opposing forces. Describing it only as a contest between superpowers would obscure Afghan political choices, coercion and the experiences of communities facing violence.

Refugee movement into Iran and other neighboring settings changed older patterns of labor migration. Departure, legal status and later return were different processes, and withdrawal of Soviet forces in 1989 did not end Afghanistan’s wars or automatically make return possible for everyone. This entry links political intervention to displacement while avoiding a single refugee count detached from date and place. The pin at Kabul marks one institutional setting, not the geographic extent of the conflict.
summary.zh:
苏军于1979年12月进入阿富汗，此前经历阿富汗政治动荡和苏联介入加深。随后的战争把地方斗争同冷战干预及对反对武装的外部支持相连。若只写成超级大国竞争，就会遮蔽阿富汗政治选择、强制以及遭受暴力的社群经验。

流向伊朗等邻近地区的难民运动，改变了原有劳工迁移模式。离境、法律地位和后来的返乡是不同过程；1989年苏军撤出，没有结束阿富汗战争，也不使所有人自动能够返回。本条连接政治干预与流离，不采用脱离时间地点的单一难民总数。喀布尔点位只是一个制度环境，不是冲突的地理全域。

dateNote.en: 1979–1989 Soviet military-intervention focus, not the full Afghan conflict. US narrative is paired with regional migration scholarship; neither is a complete account of all Afghan perspectives.
dateNote.zh: 1979—1989年为苏联军事介入范围，不是阿富汗冲突全期。美国叙述与区域迁移研究并读，任何一种都不是所有阿富汗视角的完整记录。
